0.title: Gaming instructions
0.body:
Trench Crusade Table (dev) - a fork of LCT v1.12.1 with the Warhammer 40k systems removed.
- **Red, Blue, or Spectator seats** - Choose a player side or watch the game.
- **No setup flow** - the table loads ready to play, with a clear 51" square in the middle for the 36" or 48" battlefield: no game modes, deployment zones, objectives or START GAME. Trench Crusade scenario and deployment setup will come with the Battle code (TC-022 / TC-023).
- **Kept from LCT** - measuring bubbles, a small dice tray and roller per side, save/restore positions, LOS markers, highlight paint, chess clock (the HUD now only carries help and the clock), auto-seat, table themes, terrain tools.
- **Trench Crusade content** - rules shelf, Trench Crusade dice rollers, Points/Turn/Glory counters, Blood/Blessing/Activated/Down/Tough/Objective bags, Turn Tracker. See the "Trench Crusade content" tab.
- **Removed** - missions, secondaries, CP, 40k scoring, map/Battlemaster caches, game modes, deployment zones, objective markers, table quarter / reserve / territory toggles, 40k token bags, the LCT turn / round / phase engine, Lethal / Sustained Hits, coherency, engagement range, mass-dice buttons, squad activation and wound trackers, hide-army zones. See mod/STRIP-LOG.md and mod/TESTING.md in the repo.

2.title: Trench Crusade content
2.body:
Trench Crusade content ported from "Trench Crusade 1.0.2 - Scripted Table" (3603166284) and Gannel's Model Corner (3700111403).

**Rules shelf** (x=102, raised ledge beyond the Start Menu; press Rules shelf on the Turn Tracker to look at it):
- Trench Crusade Digital Rulebook 1.0.2 (buttons jump to Core Rules, Comprehensive Rules, Injury Table, Keywords, Battlekit, Campaign, Scenarios)
- Warbands of Trench Crusade 1.0.2 (buttons jump to each faction)
- Trench Crusade FAQ 1.0.1
- TC Tactics Guide (community, 291 pp)
- Red Brigade warband supplement
- The Great Hunger playtest summary

**Turn Tracker** (dark tile in the side column left of the battlefield, above the Warband Importer; the Battlefield panel is below it): Initiative roll-off, Start turn (clears every Activated token), Morale reminder, Next turn (sets both Turn counters), Red/Blue Shaken flags.
**Dice**: the Trench Crusade Dice Roller pads (beside each dice tray) roll 2+N dice and report the two highest (+DICE) or lowest (-DICE) - use them for Success and Injury Rolls. The LCT dice tray at the end of each player's row is the alternative: spawn up to 10 dice, roll, and it shows the face counts, the total and the two highest / two lowest.
**Counters** in each player's row: Points, Turn, Glory (left click +1, right click -1).
**Token bags** (one row per player): Blood Marker, Blessing Marker, Activated, Down, Tough, Objective. Tokens carry a tc-token:<role> tag; Start turn deletes every tc-token:activated object on the table.
**Turn structure** (rulebook p32): Initiative -> Activation -> Morale, driven by the Turn Tracker (the only turn engine on the table).
